title: Zen Garden
tagline: Set five stones in a line on raked gravel.
blurb: Slate and quartz on a raked temple bed. Lay five in a row before your rival as the seasons drift past the garden wall.
description: Gomoku (five in a row) on a raked gravel bed inside a temple garden. Take turns setting slate and quartz stones on the crossings; the first unbroken line of five or more wins. Each stone ripples the gravel, the light moves through the day as the bed fills, and a five is brushed in vermilion and sealed with a stamp. Three garden sizes, spring blossom, autumn maples or winter snow, hotseat for two, or sit across from the Monk, who hunts for forced wins built from fours.
